title: Step 5 — Upload your brand, logos and icons
summary: Confirm your brand name and business category, then upload logos and icons for dark and light backgrounds so the platform carries your branding.
bodyMd:
Confirm your brand name, choose a primary business category, and upload your logos and icons so the platform shows your branding in HQ Admin, Retail Admin, mobile store sites and every email it sends.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account with the Admin role (the Master Admin account from installation is fine).
  • Transparent PNG files of your company logo and icon, in versions for dark backgrounds and for light backgrounds. Logos must be 1MB or smaller; icons 512KB or smaller.
  • Optional: your brand guidelines as a PDF, for the platform's AI agents and skills to follow — see Upload your brand guidelines for the AI agents for what to include.

Set the brand name and business category


Upload logos and icons


The first pair of assets is shown on dark backgrounds (for example the HQ Admin navigation) and the second pair on light backgrounds (for example emails and mobile store sites). Upload all 4 so every surface shows your brand correctly.

Verify it worked

Your logo appears at the top of the HQ Admin left navigation in place of the default, and Brand Name and Primary Business Category show the saved values when you reopen Brand / Logo / Guidelines.

Troubleshooting

The upload is refused

Cause. The file is over the size limit or is not a PNG.

Fix. Export a transparent PNG of 1MB or less for a logo, or 512KB or less for an icon, and upload again.
